QUOTE: "Patterns are strings matched with `fnmatch` (flags 0, so `*` also crosses `/`). Each has the form `tool` or `tool:argpattern`." and "**`tool` with no colon** (`filesystem.read_file`): matches the tool name only, for any arguments."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer states fnmatch matching and that a pattern with no colon matches the tool name only. It never says the pattern is split at the first colon into a tool part and an argument part. It only says the tool part must match and then the full string must match.
